The British army captured Surapura.

There is confusion regarding Venkatappa Nayaka’s end.

answer.value:
The death of Aurangzeb, the Mughal emperor in 1707 was the main reason.
His death weakened the Mughal empire.
Mughal lost political control over South India.
A lot of political struggles took place in Carnatic region.
British tightened their political grip over India.
India underwent many political transitions.
The native rulers opposed British in many ways.
Various political challenges in Mysuru state.
Led to Battle of Plassey & Buxar, Anglo - Mysore & Maratha Wars.

He took over government offices at Bellare
He looted the jail and treasury of Bantwal
He killed the Sulya Amaldhar
The British captured Puttabasappa and imprisoned him.

questions.text: “The protest of Halagali Bedas against the British rule was an important armed rebellion.” How?
questions.text_as_printed: “The protest of Halagali Bedas against the British rule was an important armed rebellion.” How? (Difficult)

answer.value:
Halagali is a small village of Mudhol taluk.
The British banned the usage of weapons.
Bedas who always kept guns as customs.
They rebelled against the British.
When they were asked to surrender their firearms.
Bedas of Manturu, Boodani, neighbouring villages joined Halagali Bedas.
The British army entered Halagali to suppress the rebellion.
They suppressed the Bedas in an inhuman way.
All the rebels were hanged to death.
